buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA Bidders shall mandatorily submit all the documents specified under the eligibility criteria. Failure to submit any of th e required documents shall result in the summary rejection of the bid. 1. Availability of Office of the Service Provider An office of the Service Provider must be located in the State of Telangana to ensure better coordination and service delivery. Documentary evidence shall be uploaded along with the bid offer.otherwise offer will be summarily rej ected. 2. Financial Standing and Non-Debarment of the Bidder The bidder must not have been declared bankrupt or insolvent, placed under liquidation or court receivership, or sub jected to any similar proceedings during the last five years. Further, the bidder must not have been banned or debarred, as on the date of submission of the bid, by any Central Government or State Government, any agency of the Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or R egulatory Authority in India.The bidder shall upload an undertaking to this effect along with the bid.otherwise offe r will be summarily rejected. 3. Submission of Undertaking Certifying the Truthfulness of Documents All bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness and authenticity of all documents submitted/uploa ded along with the tender.Submission of this undertaking is mandatory for all bidders. In case of failure to submit th e undertaking, the offer shall be summarily rejected.The undertaking shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-I of the Buyer-uploaded ATC document. 4. Undertaking Regarding Engagement of Retired/Existing Railway Employees The bidders shall submit the following documents along with their bid offers: (i) Undertaking regarding the engagement of retired/existing Railway employees, as per Annexure-D1.(ii) Declaratio n, as per Annexure-D2. Both documents shall be submitted in the prescribed formats provided in the Buyer-uploade d ATC document. otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. 5. Work Experience The bidders shall submit work experience certificates in support of satisfactorily completed works of a similar nature during the last three preceding financial years and the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender . The bidder must have satisfactorily completed one similar single service contract for a value of not less than 35 % of the advertised bid value.The certificate shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-II of the Bu yer-uploaded ATC document. Note: A completed service contract shall also include an ongoing service contract, subject to the condition that pay ments against bills amounting to at least 35% of the advertised bid value have been received. Definition of Similar Work: Similar work shall mean: “Providing integrated Facility Management services (comprising housekeeping, horticulture /garden maintenance, operation and maintenance of building services such as·electrical installations, plumbing, HV AC,STP; RO plants and fire-fighting systems) through deployment of manpower, in any educational institutions such as IRIFM/IITs//IIMs/ISB or any central government organisation / Any Central PSUs.”

Such experience should pertain to the last three financial years and the current financial year up to the tender date. Note: Only works of a similar nature physically completed within the qualifying period, i.e., the last three financial y ears and the current financial year, shall be considered for evaluating the minimum eligibility criteria, even if the wo rk commenced before the qualifying period. 6. Financial Standing The bidders shall satisfy the following minimum financial capability requirements: (i) T1 – Annual Turnover The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover of not less than 1.5 times the advertised bid value during th e last three preceding financial years and the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender. The audited Balance Sheet reflecting the financial turnover, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant with stamp, sig nature and membership number, shall be considered. The certificate shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-VI of the Buyer-uploaded ATC document. For the current financial year, a provisional Balance Sheet issued by a Chartered Accountant, clearly indicating contr actual receipts and supported by the Income Tax Form 26AS, shall be considered. Notes: A) The financial year shall normally be reckoned from 1st April to 31st March of the succeeding year. However, for t he purpose of turnover criteria, the financial year applicable to the Company/Tenderer shall be considered, if it diffe rs from the above. B) The current financial year shall be reckoned as the incomplete financial year in which the date of submission of t he tender falls. C) Statements issued by a Chartered Accountant indicating yearly receipts shall not be considered unless they are s upported by audited Balance Sheets or a provisional Balance Sheet along with Form 26AS issued by the Income Tax Department. D) If the tender is not accompanied by the requisite certificate(s) in support of financial eligibility, the tender shall b e rejected. No post-tender correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. (ii) T2 – Liquidity The bidder should have access to, or possess, liquid assets, lines of credit and other financial resources sufficient to meet the cash-flow requirement equivalent to 5% of the estimated bid value, net of the applicant's commitments to wards other contracts. The bidder shall submit an audited Balance Sheet and/or a banking reference, duly certified by a Chartered Account ant with stamp, signature and membership number, along with the bid. The banking reference shall clearly indicate the amount that the bank would be in a position to lend to the applicant /member of the Joint Venture/Consortium for execution of this work. In cases where the Net Current Assets, as reflected in the Balance Sheet, are negative, only banking references shal l be considered. Otherwise, the aggregate of Net Current Assets and the submitted banking references shall be cons idered for assessing liquidity. The banking reference shall be issued by a Scheduled Bank in India and shall not be more than three months old as on the date of submission of bids. The banking reference shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-III of the Buyer-uploaded ATC do

cument. 7. Constitution of the Firm/Company/Society and Submission of Relevant Documents The bidder shall furnish complete details regarding the constitution of the Firm/Company/Society, etc., and shall als o submit the following documents, as applicable, in addition to the documents mentioned above: (a) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit a notarised copy of the affidavit. (b) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of the following documents: (i) registered/notarized Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorizing one or more of the partners of t he firm or any other persons(s), authorized by all the partners to act on behalf of the firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign Measurement Books, receive payment, make correspondence s, compromise/settle/ relinquish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certificate', refer all or any disput e to arbitration and to take similar action in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (c) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Ventures are not permitted/allowed, in accordance with Para 2.4.1 of the GCC for Services uploaded as part of t he Service Level Agreement (SLA). (d) Company Registered under the Companies Act, 1956: The bidder shall submit the following documents: (i) Copies of the Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA) of the Company. (ii) Power of Attorney, duly registered/notarised by the Company and supported by a resolution of the Board of Direc tors, in favour of the individual authorised to sign the bid on behalf of the Company. (e) Society: The bidder shall submit the following documents:(i) Self-attested copy of the Certificate of Registration.(ii) Deed of F ormation.(iii) Power of Attorney in favour of the authorised tender signatory. 8. Minimum Qualifying Marks for Technical Bid Each bidder shall be assigned marks based on the evaluation of the technical bid.The technical bid must secure mar ks equal to or higher than the minimum qualifying marks prescribed for this tender.The minimum qualifying marks f or this bid shall be 60 marks. The marking scheme/system for assigning marks shall be as specified in the Buyer-uploaded ATC bid document. 9. Submission of Documents After Tender Opening No new documents, which were not part of the original bid offer uploaded by the Service Provider before the openin g of the GeM bid, shall be considered for bid evaluation after tender opening. The bidder's offer shall be summarily rejected if any of the certificates/documents required under the Specifications, Bid Document, Buyer-Added Bid-Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), or Corrigendum, if any, are not upl oaded along with the original bid offer. B. SPECIAL CONDITIONS

1. Reading of Tender Documents Service Providers are advised to carefully read the PDF documents relating to the Scope of Work, Payment Terms, P enalties, etc., before quoting their rates. 2. Applicability of GeM SLA, GTC and GCC for Services This tender shall be governed by the GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA), General Terms and Conditions (GTC) of G eM and the Scope of Work, wherein the special conditions are specified. In situations where the relevant rules/guidelines/clauses are not specifically covered under the bid conditions, the re levant clauses/paragraphs of the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) for Services shall be applicable. In the event of any conflict, inconsistency or ambiguity between the provisions of GeM General Terms and Condition s (GTC), GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA) and GCC for Services, 2018, the matter shall be governed by the provi sions of GCC for Services, 2018, and the final clarification/interpretation shall be as per the said GCC. The GCC for Services, 2018, along with its amendments issued up to the date of opening of the tender, is available o n the Railway Board website. The hyperlink for the GCC for Services of Indian Railways is given below: https://indianrailways.gov.in/railwayboard/uploads/directorate/Transformation_Cell/Circulars/General_Condition_Cont ract_Service.pdf 3. Assignment and Sub-contracting (a) The Seller shall not assign or subcontract the Contract, in whole or in part, to any third party without obtaining t he prior written approval of the Buyer. (c) Notwithstanding any such consent for assignment/sub-contracting, the Seller shall remain jointly and severally li able and responsible to the Buyer, along with the assignee/sub-contractor, for the due performance of the Contract and fulfilment of all obligations arising thereunder. 4. Performance Guarantee (PG) The successful bidder shall deposit a Performance Guarantee (PG) equivalent to 5% of the contractual value. The successful bidder shall submit the Performance Guarantee within 30 (thirty) days from the date of issue of the G eM Contract. An extension of time for submission of the PG beyond 30 days, up to the actual date of submission, ma y be granted by the Sr.DMM/HYB. However, penal interest at the rate of 15% per annum shall be charged for the del ay beyond 30 days, i.e., from the 31st day after the date of issue of the GeM Contract.In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG within 60 days from the date of issue of the GeM Contract, a notice shall be served on the c ontractor directing immediate submission of the PG. However, the submission shall not be permitted beyond 90 day s from the date of issue of the GeM Contract. If the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of issue of the Contract, the Contr act shall be terminated, duly forfeiting the EMD and any other dues, if payable against the Contract.The defaulting c ontractor shall also be debarred from participating in the re-tendering process for the same work.In case the 60th d ay falls on a bank holiday or office closure day, the next working day shall be considered the last date for submissio n of the PG.The decision of Sr.DMM/HYB shall be final in case of any dispute. 5. Bill Passing and Bill Paying Officers The Bill Passing Officer shall be PROFESSOR ACCOUNTS/IRIFM in cases of offline bill payment, or as per the GeM process in cases of online bill payment.The Bill Paying Officer shall be Sr.DFM/HYB.

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA Bidders shall mandatorily submit all the documents specified under the eligibility criteria. Failure to submit any of th e required documents shall result in the summary rejection of the bid. 1. Availability of Office of the Service Provider An office of the Service Provider must be located in the State of Telangana to ensure better coordination and service delivery. Documentary evidence shall be uploaded along with the bid offer.otherwise offer will be summarily rej ected. 2. Financial Standing and Non-Debarment of the Bidder The bidder must not have been declared bankrupt or insolvent, placed under liquidation or court receivership, or sub jected to any similar proceedings during the last five years. Further, the bidder must not have been banned or debarred, as on the date of submission of the bid, by any Central Government or State Government, any agency of the Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or R egulatory Authority in India.The bidder shall upload an undertaking to this effect along with the bid.otherwise offe r will be summarily rejected. 3. Submission of Undertaking Certifying the Truthfulness of Documents All bidders shall submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness and authenticity of all documents submitted/uploa ded along with the tender.Submission of this undertaking is mandatory for all bidders. In case of failure to submit th e undertaking, the offer shall be summarily rejected.The undertaking shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-I of the Buyer-uploaded ATC document. 4. Undertaking Regarding Engagement of Retired/Existing Railway Employees The bidders shall submit the following documents along with their bid offers: (i) Undertaking regarding the engagement of retired/existing Railway employees, as per Annexure-D1.(ii) Declaratio n, as per Annexure-D2. Both documents shall be submitted in the prescribed formats provided in the Buyer-uploade d ATC document. otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. 5. Work Experience The bidders shall submit work experience certificates in support of satisfactorily completed works of a similar nature during the last three preceding financial years and the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender . The bidder must have satisfactorily completed one similar single service contract for a value of not less than 35 % of the advertised bid value.The certificate shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-II of the Bu yer-uploaded ATC document. Note: A completed service contract shall also include an ongoing service contract, subject to the condition that pay ments against bills amounting to at least 35% of the advertised bid value have been received. Definition of Similar Work: Similar work shall mean: “Providing integrated Facility Management services (comprising housekeeping, horticulture /garden maintenance, operation and maintenance of building services such as·electrical installations, plumbing, HV AC,STP; RO plants and fire-fighting systems) through deployment of manpower, in any educational institutions such as IRIFM/IITs//IIMs/ISB or any central government organisation / Any Central PSUs.”

Such experience should pertain to the last three financial years and the current financial year up to the tender date. Note: Only works of a similar nature physically completed within the qualifying period, i.e., the last three financial y ears and the current financial year, shall be considered for evaluating the minimum eligibility criteria, even if the wo rk commenced before the qualifying period. 6. Financial Standing The bidders shall satisfy the following minimum financial capability requirements: (i) T1 – Annual Turnover The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover of not less than 1.5 times the advertised bid value during th e last three preceding financial years and the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender. The audited Balance Sheet reflecting the financial turnover, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant with stamp, sig nature and membership number, shall be considered. The certificate shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-VI of the Buyer-uploaded ATC document. For the current financial year, a provisional Balance Sheet issued by a Chartered Accountant, clearly indicating contr actual receipts and supported by the Income Tax Form 26AS, shall be considered. Notes: A) The financial year shall normally be reckoned from 1st April to 31st March of the succeeding year. However, for t he purpose of turnover criteria, the financial year applicable to the Company/Tenderer shall be considered, if it diffe rs from the above. B) The current financial year shall be reckoned as the incomplete financial year in which the date of submission of t he tender falls. C) Statements issued by a Chartered Accountant indicating yearly receipts shall not be considered unless they are s upported by audited Balance Sheets or a provisional Balance Sheet along with Form 26AS issued by the Income Tax Department. D) If the tender is not accompanied by the requisite certificate(s) in support of financial eligibility, the tender shall b e rejected. No post-tender correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. (ii) T2 – Liquidity The bidder should have access to, or possess, liquid assets, lines of credit and other financial resources sufficient to meet the cash-flow requirement equivalent to 5% of the estimated bid value, net of the applicant's commitments to wards other contracts. The bidder shall submit an audited Balance Sheet and/or a banking reference, duly certified by a Chartered Account ant with stamp, signature and membership number, along with the bid. The banking reference shall clearly indicate the amount that the bank would be in a position to lend to the applicant /member of the Joint Venture/Consortium for execution of this work. In cases where the Net Current Assets, as reflected in the Balance Sheet, are negative, only banking references shal l be considered. Otherwise, the aggregate of Net Current Assets and the submitted banking references shall be cons idered for assessing liquidity. The banking reference shall be issued by a Scheduled Bank in India and shall not be more than three months old as on the date of submission of bids. The banking reference shall be submitted in the prescribed format as per Annexure-III of the Buyer-uploaded ATC do
